user.title: Set up VOICEVOX TTS
user.description: Please enter the host and port of the server running the VOICEVOX Engine.

speaker_selection.title: Select a voice
speaker_selection.description: Choose the voice for VOICEVOX TTS.

data_description.volume: Setting a high volume may cause sound cracking or damage to your audio device. It is recommended to use a high volume only if the volume is insufficient with the pitch changed.
data_description.use_streaming: When running a version of the VOICEVOX Engine that supports streaming talk, audio streaming starts playback before audio generation is complete. Turn this off if audio playback is interrupted.
